01 / A little introduction

Hello, I’m Huzaifa.

My name is Huzaifa Aqeel, and I am currently studying in Matric (Class 10). Alongside my education, I’m learning practical digital skills and exploring the creative and technical side of the online world.

I have completed a Digital Marketing course through DigiSkills.pk. I have also completed learning MS Word, MS Excel, MS PowerPoint and Graphic Designing. I’m currently learning ADIT and Video Editing, and I plan to keep improving through practice and future projects.
